scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --workspace server run dev" "npm --workspace client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.build:public: npm --workspace server run validate:urls && npm --workspace server run export:public && npm --workspace client run build -- --mode public
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --workspace server run start" "npm --workspace client run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0"
